title: zingbus Travel Insurance: Coverage, Claims and Exclusions
summary: What zingbus travel insurance actually covers, the sum insured for each benefit, who the insurer is, and the exact claim process and deadlines.
body_markdown:
Most passengers never open the insurance terms attached to a bus booking. The cover sits there quietly, unread, until the one journey where something goes wrong and nobody knows what to do next. The policy behind zingbus travel insurance is a real Tata AIG group policy with defined benefits, defined limits and a defined claim window. Knowing the shape of it before you travel is more useful than discovering it afterwards.


## **Understanding the Cover Attached to Your Booking**


This guide breaks down what zingbus travel insurance includes, the sum insured against each benefit, who underwrites the policy and how a claim is actually filed. It also covers the conditions that decide whether a claim is admissible.


Every figure here comes from the current policy terms published on the[zingbus insurance terms and conditions page](https://www.zingbus.com/insurance-tnc) . Where the policy language is technical, this guide explains it in plain terms, but the policy document remains the governing source.


# **zingbus Travel Insurance: Coverage, Claims and What It Actually Covers**


The policy defines the insured as a registered zingbus customer who has purchased a bus ticket and is travelling within the geographical boundaries of India. Understanding the benefit limits, the accident condition and the claim deadline is what turns a policy on paper into something usable.


## **Who Underwrites the Policy**


The policy is underwritten by Tata AIG General Insurance. Bimaplan handles claim intimation as the distribution partner. The master policyholder is GoZing Technology Private Limited, the entity behind zingbus, under master policy number 0239891923.


This matters for one practical reason. When you need to raise a claim, you are not calling the bus operator. You are contacting Bimaplan or Tata AIG directly, and the contact details for both are published in the policy terms.


Age eligibility runs from 18 to 80 years for adults. Children are covered from 6 months to 18 years.


## **How the Cover Is Applied to a Booking**


Travel insurance is included as a benefit for[zingprime](https://www.zingbus.com/prime) members on bookings made through the zingbus website or mobile app. Passengers who are not zingprime members can purchase travel insurance separately at the checkout page while booking.


Either route places you under the same master policy with the same benefits and the same limits. Since how the cover is applied can change with current offers and platform terms, confirm what is attached to your specific booking at checkout, or check the[zingprime benefits page](https://www.zingbus.com/prime) for the current position.


## **What zingbus Travel Insurance Covers**


The policy carries eight distinct benefits, each with its own sum insured. The headline figure of ₹7.5 lakh applies to two of them rather than to the policy as a whole.


**Benefit** **Coverage up to**


Accidental Death, common carrier only ₹7,50,000


Permanent Total Disability ₹7,50,000


Medical Expenses, accident only ₹3,00,000


Outpatient Expenses, accident only ₹25,000


Loss of Baggage and Personal Effects ₹15,000


Emergency Medical Evacuation ₹10,000


Repatriation of Mortal Remains ₹10,000


Hospital Daily Cash, accident only ₹7,500


Hospital Daily Cash works differently from the others. It pays ₹750 per day for a maximum of 10 days, and a 24 hour deductible applies before the benefit begins.


Within Repatriation of Mortal Remains, the cremation component is a fixed benefit limited to ₹5,000, which covers embalming, cremation, coffin and transportation.


### **The Accident Condition That Decides Most Claims**


Four of the eight benefits carry the words “accident only” in their title, and this is the single most important thing to understand about the policy.


Medical Expenses, Hospital Daily Cash and Outpatient Expenses are all payable for injuries sustained in an accident during the trip. Falling ill on a journey is not the same thing as being injured in one. Emergency Medical Evacuation is the one benefit written to respond to either injury or illness, subject to the coverage clauses referenced in the policy schedule.


Accidental Death is further restricted to common carrier incidents, meaning the injury must occur while the insured person was a passenger on or off a common carrier. The loss must occur within twelve months of the accident.


Permanent Total Disability follows a similar twelve month logic. The disability must arise within twelve months of the accident, and any functional loss must have continued for twelve consecutive months and be total, continuous and permanent at the end of that period.


## **What the Policy Does Not Cover**


Every group travel policy carries exclusions, and reading them is more useful than assuming the cover is universal. The zingbus policy separates its exclusions into three categories.


Some exclusions can be waived by opting for an add-on cover on payment of additional premium. These include pre-existing disease and its complications, participation in adventure sports for leisure under expert supervision, and loss connected with any act of terrorism.


Standard exclusions apply across the policy and its add-ons. These cover radioactive and nuclear contamination, and losses arising from war, invasion, civil war, rebellion, insurrection and related events.


The third category cannot be waived at all. The most relevant of these for ordinary travellers:


- Travelling against the advice of a medical practitioner, or travelling for the purpose of obtaining treatment
- Treatment that could reasonably be delayed until the insured person returns home
- Suicide, attempted suicide or wilful self-inflicted injury, except injury in self-defence or to save life
- Being under the influence of intoxicating liquor or drugs, unless the insured is not directly responsible for the accident
- Participation in a felony, riot, crime or civil commotion, or any illegal act
- Adventure sports without expert supervision, and professional sports
- AYUSH treatment, hydrotherapy, acupuncture, reflexology and other alternative treatment
- Any treatment taken outside India
- Losses connected with pregnancy or childbirth
- Confinement in hospital that is not medically necessary


Claims occurring in a geographic zone, city or state not specifically covered under the policy are also excluded.


## **How to Make a Claim**


The claim process has a timeline, and missing it is the most avoidable reason a valid claim fails.


**Intimation window.** Notify Bimaplan within 48 hours to 7 days of the incident, or as soon as reasonably possible. The outer limit is 30 days from the date of occurrence. The policy treats notice within seven days as the condition precedent, with 30 days as the absolute maximum.


**Immediate steps at the time of the incident.** Take steps to protect, save or recover the covered property. Give immediate notice to the carrier or bailee who may be liable for the loss or damage. In case of robbery or theft, notify the police within 24 hours.


**Contacts for claim initiation.** Bimaplan can be reached at support.myavio@bimaplan.co. Tata AIG handles claim queries, intimation and document submission at 1800 119966 or 022 6489 8282, with a separate line at 1800 2671955 for senior citizen policyholders. Their claims email is general.claims@tataaig.com.


**Document scrutiny.** The insurer scrutinises the claim and the accompanying documents. If anything is missing, the deficiency is communicated to the insured person.


### **What to Keep From Your Journey**


Nothing in the policy requires you to carry paperwork, but claims move faster when the basic record exists.


Keep the booking confirmation and PNR, since these establish that you were a registered customer travelling on a purchased ticket. Retain original medical bills, the discharge summary and prescriptions for any accident related treatment. For theft or robbery, the police complaint filed within 24 hours becomes central to the claim. For baggage loss, note what was lost and hold on to any purchase receipts you have.


Photographs with timestamps are useful. So is a written note of the date, time and location of the incident made while the details are fresh.


## **How This Compares With Buying Cover Separately**


Standalone domestic travel insurance in India typically covers a broader range of situations, including trip cancellation, missed connections and illness related medical expenses. Those policies are paid products, priced per trip or per year, and they are the right choice for travellers who want cover beyond accidents.


The cover attached to a zingbus booking is narrower by design. It is built around the risks specific to a bus journey: accidental injury, baggage loss and the serious outcomes of a road accident. For a single intercity trip, that is a meaningful layer of protection. For a longer or more complex itinerary, it is a base layer rather than a complete one.


Frequent travellers who expect to book repeatedly may find the membership route more practical, since zingprime bundles the insurance with booking discounts and a free cancellation window. The benefits and limits remain those set out in the master policy either way.


## **Reading the Policy Before You Need It**


The most useful thing a passenger can do with travel insurance is spend five minutes with it before the journey rather than after an incident. The benefit limits, the accident condition and the seven day intimation window are the three things worth remembering.


The complete terms, including the full exclusion list and the detailed wording of each base cover, are published on the[insurance terms page](https://www.zingbus.com/insurance-tnc) . Policy terms are periodically revised, so the published document is always the current reference.

## **Common Questions About Insurance Cover on a zingbus Ticket**


### **Is zingbus travel insurance free?**


It is included as a zingprime member benefit on app and website bookings. Non-members can purchase the cover separately at the checkout page.


### **What is the maximum coverage amount?**


The highest sum insured is ₹7,50,000, which applies to Accidental Death for common carrier incidents and to Permanent Total Disability.


### **Who is the insurer behind the policy?**


Tata AIG General Insurance underwrites the policy. Bimaplan handles claim intimation. The master policyholder is GoZing Technology Private Limited, the entity behind zingbus.


### **Does the policy cover illness during the journey?**


Medical Expenses, Hospital Daily Cash and Outpatient Expenses are accident only benefits. Emergency Medical Evacuation is the one cover written to respond to injury or illness.


### **How much is covered for lost baggage?**


Loss of Baggage and Personal Effects is covered up to ₹15,000, for the loss of an entire piece of baggage or personal effects owned by and accompanying the insured person.


### **What is the deadline to report a claim?**


Notify Bimaplan within 48 hours to 7 days of the incident. The absolute outer limit is 30 days from the date of occurrence.


### **Who do I contact to raise a claim?**


Contact Bimaplan at support.myavio@bimaplan.co, or Tata AIG at 1800 119966 for claim queries, intimation and document submission.


### **Is there an age limit for the cover?**


Adults are covered from 18 to 80 years. Children are covered from 6 months to 18 years, as set out in the policy terms.


### **How does Hospital Daily Cash work?**


It pays ₹750 per day for a maximum of 10 days, up to ₹7,500. A 24 hour deductible applies before the benefit starts.


### **Are pre-existing conditions covered?**


Pre-existing disease and its complications are excluded, though this sits in the category of exclusions that can be waived by opting for an add-on cover on additional premium.


### **Does the cover apply outside India?**


No. The policy applies to travel within the geographical boundaries of India, and any treatment taken outside India is excluded.


### **What if theft happens during the journey?**


Notify the police within 24 hours and give immediate notice to the carrier. The police complaint is central to any baggage or personal effects claim.


### **Is zingbus travel insurance the same as a full travel insurance policy?**


No. It is a group policy focused on accident related benefits and baggage loss. Standalone policies cover a wider range including trip cancellation and illness.


### **Where can I read the complete policy terms?**


The full terms, benefit table and exclusion list are published on the zingbus insurance terms and conditions page on the zingbus website.
